description.ja: クリリンがパッケージをリニューアルして登場！！
description.en: Krillin is now available with a new package! !

description.ja: 様々な劇中再現が可能なクリリンがラインアップ！マッスルをビルドせよ！
description.en: A lineup of Krillin that can be recreated in various ways from the movie! Build muscle!

description.ja: • 特徴的な額の6つの模様も差し込みパーツで再現！細かなディテールまでビルド可能！
description.en: • The six distinctive forehead patterns are also reproduced with insert parts! You can build even the smallest details!

description.ja: • 表情パーツは、「通常」、「怒り」、「驚き」の3種付属！色んなシーンを再現しよう！
description.en: • Three types of facial expression parts are included: "normal ", " angry ", and " surprised"! Let's recreate various scenes!

description.ja: • エフェクトパーツには必殺技の「気円斬」と「連続気功波」を付属でクリリンの技の豊富さを余すことなく楽しめる！
description.en: • Effect parts include the special moves "Kienzan " and " Continuous Ki Gong Wave" so you can fully enjoy the richness of Krillin's techniques!

description.ja: • 発売中のFigure-riseStandard 人造人間18号と併せて、あの名シーンも再現可能！
description.en: • In conjunction with the currently released Figure-riseStandard Android 18, you can also recreate that famous scene!

accessories.ja: 必殺技エフェクト2種（連続気功波、気円斬）×各１
accessories.en: 2 types of special move effects (continuous Qigong wave, Qienzan) x 1 each

accessories.ja: 表情パーツ3種（通常、怒り、驚き）×各1
accessories.en: 3 types of facial expression parts (normal, angry, surprised) x 1 each

accessories.ja: 手首パーツ6種（左右握り手、左右平手、左右持ち手）×各1
accessories.en: 6 types of wrist parts (left and right gripping hands, left and right palms, left and right holding hands) x 1 each
